macros.name: allowarab
macros.doc: User defined commands, even if they require parameters, may be called directly within an Arabic context if they have been previously announced to the ArabTEX processor by \allowarab{command name}.

macros.name: doassign
macros.doc: Parameter assignments inside an Arabic context may be performed by \doassign{parameter}{value}.

macros.name: spreadbox
macros.doc: \spreadbox{width}{text} spreads out the text to the indicated width.
